turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: Hi, I'm Nina Shah, and it's my birthday, so you all have to be nice to me. I teach chemistry at East High.

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: I'm Laura Bennett. I'm a graphic designer in Chicago, and I flew in this morning because I've known the birthday girl since college.

turns.speaker: Megan Walsh
turns.text: I'm Megan Walsh. I'm a nurse at Children's Hospital, and I'm in the book club with Nina.

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: Chris Porter. I'm Megan's husband, I'm an accountant, and I made the reservation tonight, so you're welcome.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: I'm Emily Hart. I'm a veterinarian in Boulder, and I'm the one who picks the depressing books for book club.

turns.speaker: Sam Torres
turns.text: Hey, I'm Sam Torres. I work at REI, and I climb with Owen most Sundays.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: I'm Owen Brooks. I'm a physical therapist, and I'm the one who drove Sam here, because his car is dead again.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: I'm Arjun Mehta. I'm a data scientist, and Chris was my college roommate at Colorado State.

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: Happy birthday, Nina! Thirty five!

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: Thirty four. Do not age me.

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: Thirty four. Sorry.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: Laura, how did you and Nina actually meet? I always forget.

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: Freshman orientation at Michigan, August 2008. They put us in the same group for the campus tour, and Nina asked the tour guide so many questions about the chemistry building that the whole group fell twenty minutes behind. I thought she was the most annoying person I had ever met. Then we ended up on the same floor of the dorm, and by October we were inseparable.

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: That was 2009, wasn't it?

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: Nina. We graduated in 2012. It was 2008.

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: Oh, right, 2008. Okay, I'm already confused and I've only had one drink.

turns.speaker: Megan Walsh
turns.text: And you two lived together after college, right?

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: In Chicago, for six years, until Nina abandoned me for Denver.

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: In 2019. And you visit every summer, so stop complaining.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: Chris, should I tell them how we met, or will you?

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: Go ahead. You tell it worse than me.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: Fall of 2011, Colorado State. Chris and I got randomly assigned as roommates in the same tiny dorm room. The very first night, he set off the smoke alarm making ramen in an electric kettle, and the whole building had to stand outside in the rain at two in the morning. Everyone was furious with him. I decided right there that anybody that bad at cooking needed a friend.

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: In my defense, the box said the kettle could do noodles.

turns.speaker: Sam Torres
turns.text: Ha, true. He still can't cook.

turns.speaker: Megan Walsh
turns.text: He really can't. I do everything.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: Arjun, you're in the fantasy football league too, right?

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: The Dynasty League, yes. Me, Chris, Sam, Kevin Doyle, and Matt Fisher. Chris and I started it in 2013.

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: 2014. We started it in 2014, the year I got my first real job.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: No, it was 2013. I still have the email.

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: You do not have the email.

turns.speaker: Sam Torres
turns.text: I joined in 2017, and I've won it twice, so honestly the founding year doesn't matter.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: That's the part that hurts the most.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: Wait, Arjun, you're getting married soon, aren't you?

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: In September! Claire and I are getting married in Napa, at a vineyard. Claire Dunn. She's a pediatric dentist, and you would all love her.

turns.speaker: Megan Walsh
turns.text: We met her at the holiday party. She's lovely.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: We met on a hiking app in 2021, which is either very romantic or very sad.

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: Very romantic. Better than how I met my ex.

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: Oh no. Are we doing the Sam Reyes story?

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: We are doing the Sam Reyes story. So Sam Reyes and I dated from 2014 to 2017 in Chicago. We met because she rear ended my car at a stoplight on Lake Shore Drive, and instead of exchanging insurance, we went and got coffee. Three years later we broke up, very calmly, like adults, and now she's honestly one of my best friends. She's coming to visit me in April.

turns.speaker: Sam Torres
turns.text: Sam Reyes, not me. Just to be clear.

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: Not you, Sam. A different Sam.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: Two Sams. This is going to get confusing.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: Speaking of exes, Hannah says happy birthday, by the way. She's stuck at a work dinner.

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: Tell her thank you! How is the wedding planning going?

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: Stressful. She texts me spreadsheets. I don't know why. I'm the ex.

turns.speaker: Megan Walsh
turns.text: Because you're the most organized person she knows.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: Okay, I have to tell you all about Iceland, because I never got to at book club.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: So my college roommate Paige Wilson and I went to Iceland in 2022. We rented this tiny car and drove the whole ring road in ten days. On day four we got a flat tire in the middle of nowhere, with no cell service at all, and this old farmer pulled over on a tractor, changed the tire for us, refused to take any money, and invited us in for lamb soup. Best meal of my entire life.

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: Wasn't that 2021? I remember seeing the photos the summer I changed jobs.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: No, 2022. Paige got married in 2021, so it couldn't have been that year.

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: I really think it was 2021.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: Agree to disagree.

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: Paige is in the book club now too, right?

turns.speaker: Megan Walsh
turns.text: She joined Second Chapter last fall. So now it's five of us. Me, Nina, Laura, Emily, and Paige.

turns.speaker: Sam Torres
turns.text: Okay. Owen, can I tell the Breckenridge story?

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: Sam Torres
turns.text: Too late. So, January 2023, the whole climbing crew goes up to Breckenridge for a ski weekend. Owen, a professional physical therapist, a person who tells other people how to avoid injuries for a living, goes off a tiny little jump on a green run, lands completely flat, and tears his ACL. On a green run.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: It was a blue run.

turns.speaker: Sam Torres
turns.text: It was a green run. There were six year olds on it.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: Okay, fine, it was a green run. And then I had to do my own rehab for eight months, and I was a terrible patient. I yelled at my own exercise bands. Megan had to come over twice a week just to make me do my exercises.

turns.speaker: Megan Walsh
turns.text: He cried at the leg press. I have witnesses.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: No way!

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: Okay, everyone, raise a glass. To Nina.

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: To Nina!

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: Thank you. Honestly, I'm so lucky. Six years ago I didn't know a single person here.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: Nina, what was your favorite birthday ever?

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: Probably my twenty first, in Ann Arbor, in 2012. Laura threw me a surprise party in our tiny apartment and invited like forty people. Then the landlord showed up, and instead of shutting it down, he stayed and danced until two in the morning. I still think about that landlord a lot.

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: Ha, true. He was the best dancer there.

turns.speaker: Sam Torres
turns.text: Megan, are you and Chris going to Napa for Arjun's wedding?

turns.speaker: Megan Walsh
turns.text: Yes, we already booked the flights. It's our first trip without the dog.

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: I'm a groomsman, so I have to give a speech. I'm terrified.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: Do not mention the kettle.

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: I am absolutely mentioning the kettle.

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: Laura, did Sam ever pay you back for those concert tickets?

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: Not yet. Still waiting.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: Okay, I have to ask. Owen, are you seeing anyone?

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: I am not answering that at a birthday dinner.

turns.speaker: Sam Torres
turns.text: His only relationship right now is with his trivia team.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: The Know It Alls are a serious commitment. We came in second last week.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: Who's on that team?

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: Me, my roommates Lucy Ford and Ravi Kapoor, and Ben Carter, Megan's cousin.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: Wait. Ravi Kapoor? Ravi is my cousin!

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.text: No way. Ravi never told me that.

turns.speaker: Arjun Mehta
turns.text: Our moms are sisters. He's coming to the wedding too.

turns.speaker: Megan Walsh
turns.text: Denver is so small.

turns.speaker: Emily Hart
turns.text: Okay, cake time. Nina, make a wish.

turns.speaker: Nina Shah
turns.text: I wish that next year we all do this again. Same table, same people.

turns.speaker: Laura Bennett
turns.text: And that Chris doesn't burn anything.

turns.speaker: Chris Porter
turns.text: One time! One kettle!

turns.speaker: Sam Torres
turns.text: Happy birthday, Nina.
